territorial_scope.description: Executive decree of Argentina; applies to RIGI projects and suppliers in Argentina, with cross-border effects through imports, exports, foreign capital and foreign beneficiaries referenced in the text.

evidence.quote: Prorrógase la vigencia del plazo para acogerse al Régimen de Incentivo de Grandes Inversiones (RIGI)

summary.short: Decree 105/2026 extends by one year, from 8 July 2026, the deadline to join Argentina's RIGI large-investment incentive regime and amends Decree 749/2024's implementing rules on sector definitions (including artificial intelligence in the technology sector), imports, expansions, depreciation, dividend tax rate, foreign-exchange access and procedure. In force on publication.
summary.long: Decree 105/2026, published 19 February 2026 and in force on publication, amends the implementing regulation of Argentina's RIGI large-investment incentive regime (Decree 749/2024, Annex I). Article 1 extends by one year, from 8 July 2026, the period to adhere to the RIGI. Article 2 redefines the technology sector, which now includes artificial intelligence, and the oil and gas sector, which adds new onshore developments and offshore exploration and production. Article 8 allows expansions of pre-existing non-RIGI technology projects through a new product, subject to a USD 250 million minimum investment and a product life of up to ten years. Articles 3, 4 and 13 regulate imports by RIGI suppliers and import exemptions for capital goods. Article 11 sets optional accelerated depreciation and annual useful-life declarations to the tax agency; Article 12 sets a 7% dividend rate. Article 14 lets the Central Bank condition foreign-exchange market access for RIGI projects. Articles 15 to 17 cover supplier registry withdrawal, a 30-business-day defence period and the evaluation committee. Addressees are RIGI project companies, goods and service suppliers and public authorities.

notes: Source: Boletín Oficial page for Decreto 105/2026, signed 18/02/2026 and published 19/02/2026; the header date 13/10/2026 is the page-view date. Only substituted or inserted text of Anexo I is annotated; restated unchanged text is not coded. Art. 5 says minimum investment amounts by sector are: but the amounts table is absent from the fetched text, so no sector amounts are coded. The recitals mention USD 600 million and USD 200 million for oil and gas projects and USD 250 million for expansions (art. 8), but the operative figures are only in art. 8(b) and art. 60. Art. 2 adds inteligencia artificial to the technology sector definition in Anexo I art. 3, inciso n, apartado (v). Art. 8 extends the expansion route to new products in the technology sector. The text does not name the Autoridad de Aplicación. Entity ids and relation target ids are empty strings because the registry has no matching entries in this input.

obligations.conditional_on: Applies only to funds effectively used for the Unique Project and processed under Central Bank procedures.

obligations.summary: Suppliers of goods or services with imported merchandise may request voluntary deregistration from the RIGI Supplier Registry at any time, provided they have met obligations from RIGI operations and have no pending infraction proceedings or final sanctions.
obligations.applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
obligations.conditional_on: Subject to the conditions stated in the provision.

obligations.summary: The Application Authority must evaluate deregistration requests from suppliers and ensure that the deregistration does not affect rights or obligations arising from earlier operations under the regime.
obligations.applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to deregistration requests under Art. 113 as amended.

obligations.summary: In a sanctioning proceeding against the VPU, the VPU must present its evidence in defence within a maximum of 30 business days from the start of the procedure.
obligations.applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
obligations.conditional_on: Applies when a proceeding (sumario) is opened against the VPU.

evidence.quote: deberá presentar las pruebas que hagan a su derecho de defensa dentro de un plazo máximo de TREINTA (30) días hábiles de iniciado el procedimiento

obligations.applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)

enforcement.penalty_formula: Reintegro to the tax balance of the special depreciation deducted, counted as taxable gain in the fiscal year of the deduction, plus interest, accessories and sanctions under Ley 11.683 (amounts not stated in this text).

enforcement.penalty_formula: Not stated in this text; the infractional regime is applied by cross-reference to Ley 27.742, Title VII, Chapter VIII.
